source: CHED CMO No. 15 s. 2017 — Philippine Nursing Education Curriculum (BSN Program)
note: Core competency areas for nursing practice. Instructors may extend this file with their own institutional competencies.

core_competency_areas.name: Safe, Quality Nursing Care
core_competency_areas.description: Demonstrate knowledge and skills in the safe, compassionate, and quality nursing care to individuals, families, and communities.
sub_competencies: Assess health status and needs of clients
Formulate and implement nursing care plans
Evaluate client outcomes and revise care
Observe safety protocols and infection control

core_competency_areas.name: Management of Resources and Environment
core_competency_areas.description: Manage the nursing care environment, resources, and equipment to promote safe and effective care.
sub_competencies: Organize and maintain a safe care environment
Apply principles of waste segregation and disposal

core_competency_areas.name: Health Education
core_competency_areas.description: Provide health education to individuals, families, and communities using appropriate teaching-learning strategies.

core_competency_areas.name: Legal Responsibility and Accountability
core_competency_areas.description: Practice nursing within the legal and ethical boundaries of the profession.
sub_competencies: Apply provisions of the Nursing Practice Act (RA 9173)
Observe the Code of Ethics for Nurses
Document nursing care accurately and legally
Recognize and report negligence, malpractice, and abuse

core_competency_areas.name: Ethico-Moral Responsibility
core_competency_areas.description: Demonstrate ethical decision-making and moral responsibility in nursing practice.
sub_competencies: Apply ethical principles in client care
Advocate for client rights and welfare
Respect cultural, spiritual, and personal values

core_competency_areas.name: Personal and Professional Development
core_competency_areas.description: Demonstrate personal and professional growth through continuous learning and self-development.
sub_competencies: Participate in research and evidence-based practice
Reflect on personal and professional practice

core_competency_areas.name: Quality Improvement
core_competency_areas.description: Participate in quality improvement activities to enhance nursing practice and client outcomes.
sub_competencies: Identify areas for improvement in nursing care
Apply quality improvement tools and methods
Report and act on client safety incidents

core_competency_areas.name: Research
core_competency_areas.description: Utilize research findings to improve nursing practice and contribute to the body of nursing knowledge.

core_competency_areas.name: Records Management
core_competency_areas.description: Maintain accurate, complete, and confidential client records in accordance with legal and institutional standards.
sub_competencies: Use correct charting formats (e.g., SOAPIE, FDAR)
Maintain legibility and accuracy in records

core_competency_areas.name: Communication
core_competency_areas.description: Communicate effectively with clients, families, and the health care team using appropriate verbal, nonverbal, and written methods.
sub_competencies: Adapt communication to age, culture, and condition

core_competency_areas.name: Collaboration and Teamwork
core_competency_areas.description: Collaborate with clients, families, and the interprofessional health care team to achieve optimal client outcomes.
sub_competencies: Work effectively within the health care team
Participate in case conferences and referrals
